title: A Unified Issue Resolution Benchmark for Requirement Clarification, Planning, and Code Generation for Coding Agents
title_zh: SWE-RPG：面向编码智能体的需求澄清、实现规划与代码生成统一 Issue 解决基准
abstract_en: Large language model-powered coding agents are increasingly used to modify existing code repositories, for example, by adding features or fixing bugs. Yet existing repository-level benchmarks typically evaluate only whether the final patch passes tests. Satisfying a user request requires a long chain of interdependent reasoning and decisions: an agent must recover explicit and implicit requirements, formulate a repository-grounded implementation plan, and translate it into correct code. A pass/fail outcome cannot characterize how an unsuccessful trajectory diverges from the requirements and implementation process needed for a correct patch. To address this gap, we introduce SWE-RPG, a repository-level benchmark that combines executable patch evaluation with validated ground-truth references (GTs) for (1) Requirement Clarification and (2) Implementation Planning. These intermediate GTs support retrospective, GT-aligned diagnosis of complete coding-agent trajectories across clarification, planning, code generation, and artifact submission. SWE-RPG comprises 163 tasks from 31 Python and Java repositories, including 113 bug fixes and 50 feature additions. We evaluate 3 coding agents, including Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode, with 6 large language model backends, including Claude-Sonnet-5 and GPT-5.6-Terra. Results show that the evaluated popular coding agents still struggle to implement user requests in existing repositories, achieving an average resolved rate of only 31.5% on SWE-RPG. Intermediate-GT diagnosis further identifies implicit requirement recovery as the main bottleneck, accounting for 24.5%--46.0% of agent runs. This result suggests implicit-requirement recovery as a key candidate direction for improving coding agents. The benchmark data and evaluation code are available at https://github.com/Xin-Zhou-smu/SWE-RPG-Bench.
abstract_zh: 由大语言模型驱动的 coding agents 正越来越多地用于修改既有代码仓库，例如添加功能或修复 bug。然而，现有 repository-level benchmarks 通常只评估最终 patch 是否通过测试，难以刻画失败轨迹究竟在哪个环节偏离了正确实现。为弥补这一缺口，论文提出 SWE-RPG：一个仓库级 benchmark，将可执行 patch 评测与经过验证的 ground-truth references（GTs）结合起来，覆盖两类中间过程：（1）Requirement Clarification（需求澄清），（2）Implementation Planning（实现规划）。这些中间 GT 支持对完整 coding-agent 轨迹进行回溯式、GT 对齐的诊断，分析其在澄清、规划、代码生成和提交产物等阶段的问题。SWE-RPG 包含来自 31 个 Python 和 Java 仓库的 163 个任务，其中 113 个为 bug fix，50 个为 feature addition。作者评估了 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode 等 3 种 coding agents，以及 Claude-Sonnet-5、GPT-5.6-Terra 等 6 种 LLM 后端。实验显示，当前流行 coding agents 在既有仓库中完成用户请求仍然困难，SWE-RPG 上平均 resolved rate 仅为 31.5%。基于中间 GT 的诊断进一步发现，隐式需求恢复是主要瓶颈，占 agent 运行失败或偏差的 24.5%--46.0%，表明提升 implicit-requirement recovery 是改进 coding agents 的关键方向。
key_points_zh: 提出 SWE-RPG，一个 repository-level issue resolution benchmark，不仅评估最终 patch 是否通过测试，还提供需求澄清与实现规划的中间 ground-truth references。
基准包含 163 个任务，覆盖 31 个 Python 和 Java 仓库，其中包括 113 个 bug fixes 和 50 个 feature additions，更贴近真实仓库维护场景。
SWE-RPG 支持对 coding-agent 完整轨迹进行 retrospective diagnosis，分析需求理解、规划、代码生成和最终提交等阶段的偏差。
对 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode 及 6 个 LLM 后端的评测显示，平均 resolved rate 仅为 31.5%，说明当前 coding agents 在复杂仓库任务上仍表现有限。
诊断结果表明，implicit requirement recovery 是主要瓶颈，占 24.5%--46.0% 的 agent runs，是未来提升编码智能体能力的重要方向。

llm_assessment.comment: A strong coding-agent benchmark that adds intermediate requirement and planning references for trajectory-level diagnosis beyond final patch success.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一项较强的代码智能体基准，通过需求和规划中间标注支持超越最终补丁结果的轨迹诊断。
